ctaHeading: Transform Your Brooklyn Space with Quintero's Painting
aboutText: Based in Brooklyn, Quintero's Painting has been delivering high-quality painting services for over 10 years. Our team, led by Daniel, prides itself on family values, attention to detail, and exceptional results. From interior repaints to exterior cleaning, we treat every project with care. Contact us for a free quote and see why Brooklyn locals trust us.
servicesText: At Quintero's Painting, we offer a comprehensive range of painting and maintenance services tailored for Brooklyn homes and businesses. Our expertise includes traditional painting, interior and exterior coatings, line marking, and exterior cleaning. We use premium materials and meticulous techniques to ensure lasting beauty and protection.

services.title: Traditional Painting
services.desc: Expert application of classic paint finishes for walls, ceilings, and trim, ensuring a smooth and even look.

services.title: Interior Painting
services.desc: Revitalise your indoor spaces with fresh colours and professional techniques for a clean, modern feel.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Protect and beautify your home's exterior with durable paints and careful preparation against the elements.

services.title: Line Marking
services.desc: Precise line marking for safety and aesthetics in car parks, driveways, and commercial areas.

services.title: Exterior Cleaning
services.desc: Thorough cleaning of surfaces like walls and roofs to remove dirt, mould, and grime before painting.

services.title: Commercial Painting
services.desc: Specialised painting services for businesses, offices, and retail spaces, minimising disruption and ensuring quality.

reviews.text: Alex and the team at Quintero's did an absolutely fabulous job painting our house in Brooklyn. Our 80-year-old home looks beautiful again, and they were lovely to have around. Highly recommend for any painting work.
reviews.name: Jill and Paul

reviews.text: Quintero's Painting painted all the walls around our pool area with quality work and accommodated a tight timeframe. They came back for touch-ups the next day and were very friendly. Excellent result.
reviews.name: Lidia Harvey

reviews.text: From the first consultation to the final brushstroke, Daniel and his team provided professional and tidy service. They painted our entire house perfectly, and we couldn't be happier. A lifelong customer.
reviews.name: Frank Spagnolo
